caption: The drawing is a technical blueprint of a chair, rendered in black linework on a beige background. The composition shows three distinct views: a top-down view of the seat labeled "SEAT PLAN" at the upper left, a front elevation of the whole chair below it, and a side elevation to the right. Dimensions in inches are marked for various parts, such as the seat width (16” and 18”), overall chair height (36”), side profile height (20 1/2”), and the width between legs (14”). The front elevation illustrates a chair with three decorative horizontal splats on the backrest. The top-down view displays the tapered shape of the seat. All views are annotated with straight dimension lines and measurement callouts. At the top right, there is written information: "CHAIR", "Brooklyn Museum", "Scale 1/8 = 1'", "Rob't Brigadier", and a date "3/17/36." The visual is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray for the drawing and text.
title: Hitchcock Chair
